# Express path for _id lookups on sharded collections
Source: https://llms-explorer.com/tree/express-path-for-id-lookups-on-sharded-collections/

# Express path for _id lookups on sharded collections — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Express path for _id lookups on sharded collections. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-31 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## How it works

- [statement] When assessing coverage, run explain with executionStats and examine document-examination counts alongside the stage names. Covered execution must answer from index keys without examining collection documents; an Express stage label alone is insufficient evidence. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/explain-results.md · keywords: Express path for _id lookups on sharded collections · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/exec/express/express_plan.h
- [statement] In the MongoDB v8.0 implementation, makeExpressExecutorForFindById constructs IdLookupViaIndex and passes an optional ScopedCollectionFilter to the Express plan. Sharded execution therefore need not fall back merely because a collection filter is required. This is implementation evidence, not a guarantee that every _id query is eligible. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/query/plan_executor_express.cpp · keywords: Express path for _id lookups on sharded collections · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/exec/express/express_plan.h
- [statement] SERVER-108344, whose page was last updated on 2025-08-04, lists Express covering projection with a shard filter as unresolved with no fix version. Its description distinguishes projection support without a shard filter from the additional work needed when a shard filter is required. Do not generalize later unsharded projection improvements to sharded coverage. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2025-08-04) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-108344 · keywords: Express path for _id lookups on sharded collections · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-103991

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] To assess coverage, request executionStats through mongos and inspect every accessed shard, including totalDocsExamined. Coverage requires matching and returning results from index keys without examining collection documents. An empty lookup with zero examined documents alone does not demonstrate coverage for matching records. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/explain-results.md · keywords: Express path for _id lookups on sharded collections · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/exec/express/express_plan.h

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Percona documents PMM-13897 as fixed in PMM 3.2.0, released 2025-05-29: selecting MongoDB Plan Summary filters containing bracketed Express expressions previously triggered internal server errors. This is an observability-tool limitation, not evidence that Express execution or coverage failed. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-05-29) — https://docs.percona.com/percona-monitoring-and-management/3/release-notes/3.2.0.html

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Starting in MongoDB 8.0, eligible queries including _id equality matches can bypass regular query planning and execution through Express optimized index scan plans. EXPRESS_IXSCAN and EXPRESS_CLUSTERED_IXSCAN are read-stage labels; eligibility is limited rather than universal. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/8.0.md · keywords: Express path for _id lookups on sharded collections · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/explain-results.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] In the inspected v8.0 implementation, makeExpressExecutorForFindById constructs IdLookupViaIndex; that iterator seeks the local _id index and can produce at most one matching document per shard. This local bound is not a cluster-wide uniqueness guarantee. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/query/plan_executor_express.cpp · keywords: Express path for _id lookups on sharded collections · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/exec/express/express_plan.h
- [statement] The inspected v8.0 IdLookupViaIndex implementation calls findDoc after finding the RecordId and increments numDocumentsFetched for a successful fetch. Therefore EXPRESS_IXSCAN without a separate FETCH stage does not establish index-only execution, including for an _id-only projection on this path. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/exec/express/express_plan.h · keywords: Express path for _id lookups on sharded collections · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/explain-results.md
- [statement] SERVER-98300 documents that Express can perform shard filtering for simple find-by-key reads while explain shows only EXPRESS_IXSCAN on _id_, so absence of a separate SHARDING_FILTER stage does not prove absence of that work. (medium confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-98300 · keywords: Express path for _id lookups on sharded collections · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/query/plan_executor_express.cpp
- [statement] Express lookup execution and mongos targeting are separate concerns. For an _id-only find where _id supplies no shard-key field or compound shard-key prefix, mongos broadcasts to all shards; a fast local lookup does not remove that fan-out. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/sharding.md · keywords: Express path for _id lookups on sharded collections · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/v8.0/src/mongo/db/query/plan_executor_express.cpp
- [statement] Anjum reports EXPRESS_IXSCAN for a unique orderNo lookup in a standalone MongoDB 9.0.4 benchmark. That original experiment supplies independent evidence of Express execution but does not measure sharded _id lookups or isolate Express speedup. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-29) — https://fabwaseem.com/blog/mongodb-vs-postgres-jsonb
- [statement] The Foojay migration guide demonstrates an _id equality find with explain and reports EXPRESS_IXSCAN. Its demonstration supports recognizing the stage for ordinary point lookups; it supplies no sharded coverage experiment. (low confidence) — https://foojay.io/today/mongodb-8-0-migration-guide-what-you-need-to-know-before-upgrading/
- [statement] SERVER-108422 records an Express explain example that omitted its projection and lists a fix version of 8.3.0-rc0 for displaying projection and coverage information. Older Express explain output can therefore hide projection work; use version-specific explain fields and execution counters. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2025-08-04) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-108422 · keywords: Express path for _id lookups on sharded collections · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/explain-results.md
- [statement] A Graylog community user reporting MongoDB 8.0.17 posted a profiler trace on 2026-03-13 with EXPRESS_IXSCAN on unique_type, one key examined and one document examined. This independently observed example shows that Express scans can fetch documents; it tests neither _id lookup nor sharded coverage. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-03-13) — https://community.graylog.org/t/mongodb-high-activity/37077
